title: Open Mic Night @ Sunday Service Motor Co.
event_description: All-ages open mic featuring performers of all skill levels in a supportive environment. Professional PA system and keyboard provided along with microphone and instrument inputs.
backline: PA System; Keyboard; Microphone; Instrument Inputs
event_venue_information:
About Sunday Service Motor Co.

Sunday Service Motor Co. is a dynamic performance venue in Albuquerque that hosts regular open mic nights and live music events. The venue is known for its welcoming atmosphere and professional sound equipment.

Music Events

The venue hosts weekly open mic nights on Tuesday evenings organized by Rock 101 Music Academy. Musicians of all ages are welcome to perform with full backline support provided.

title: Open Mic Night @ Sandia Music and Sound
event_description: Monthly open mic showcasing raw talent across acoustic indie and various genres. All ages welcome to perform at this music store and venue.
event_venue_information:
About Sandia Music and Sound

Sandia Music and Sound is Albuquerque's locally owned musical instrument store that doubles as a performance venue through their Sandia After Dark program. The store offers instruments for purchase and rental along with music lessons.

Open Mic Events

Monthly open mic nights take place on the last Friday of each month featuring local talent across multiple genres. The venue provides a supportive environment for musicians to showcase their skills.

Store Services

The store offers a wide range of instruments including guitars brass and woodwinds with flexible rental plans. Expert staff provides personalized service and music lessons tailored to individual goals.

title: Open Mic @ Blue Grasshopper Brew Pub - Pub 3
event_description: Weekly open mic night hosted by The Spiral Pilots featuring local musicians and solo performers. Venue features craft beer and live music in a casual atmosphere.
event_venue_information:
About Blue Grasshopper Brew Pub

Blue Grasshopper Brew Pubs operate three locations in the Albuquerque area featuring craft beer live music and wood-fired pizza. Each location hosts regular open mic nights and live performances throughout the week.

Music Programming

The pubs feature everything from single solo performers to 5-piece blues bands western music to smooth jazz. Pub 3 downtown hosts weekly open mic on Wednesday nights with The Spiral Pilots while other locations feature different programming.

Atmosphere

Casual laid-back brewery atmosphere with New Mexico craft beer wine and great food including wood-fired pizza salads and sandwiches.

title: Open Mic @ Blue Grasshopper Brew Pub - Pub 2
event_description: Bi-weekly open mic hosted by Rob Roman at the Riverside Plaza location. Features local musicians in an intimate brewery setting.
venue_address: 6163 Riverside Plaza Lane NW Albuquerque NM 87120
event_venue_information:
About Blue Grasshopper Brew Pub - Pub 2

Located at Riverside Plaza this Blue Grasshopper location features regular live music and bi-weekly open mic nights. The venue offers craft beer and full food menu in a welcoming atmosphere.

Open Mic Programming

Every other Monday night Rob Roman hosts open mic sessions from 6:00 to 9:30 PM. Rob is a fingerstyle percussive guitarist who has developed a unique playing style combining folk blues and UK dance music influences.

title: Open Mic Afternoon @ Blue Grasshopper - Rio Rancho
event_description: Sunday afternoon open mic session hosted by Rob Roman at the Rio Rancho location. Family-friendly timing featuring local talent.
venue_address: 4500 Arrowhead Ridge Dr SE Rio Rancho NM 87124
event_venue_information:
About Blue Grasshopper Rio Rancho

The original Blue Grasshopper location in Rio Rancho features Sunday afternoon open mics and regular live music throughout the week. Known for craft beer wood-fired pizza and a musician-friendly atmosphere.

Sunday Open Mic

Rob Roman hosts a Sunday afternoon open mic from 1:00-4:00 PM providing a family-friendly performance opportunity. The venue also features The Spiral Pilots for open mic on Tuesday nights from 7:00-10:00 PM.
